name: Butter Crunch
request:
Build a super simple Roblox Butter Crunch game: one butter object on a small clean stage, one repeatable click/tap crunch interaction with visible animation and synchronized crunch sound, and one readable counter. Counter starts at zero, increases exactly once per completed crunch, and reads 10 after ten separated crunches. Overlapping input must not double-count. Recover/reset the object after each action. Support desktop and mobile controls. No shops, upgrades, economy, saving, monetization or unrelated gameplay. Design and write the actual game yourself.

The user's sourcing rule is mandatory:
1. ALL AUDIO MUST COME FROM CREATOR STORE / MARKETPLACE. Declare at least one Audio assetNeed for the required crunch sound with required: true, linked to a required audio requirement. This cannot be optional. No synthesized/generated audio, built-in/stock Roblox audio fallbacks, guessed IDs, placeholders or silent substitution. If the worker cannot retrieve and verify a suitable sound through Takko, fail honestly.
2. EVERYTHING ELSE IS MARKETPLACE FIRST WHERE APPLICABLE. Declare executable Model/MeshPart/Image assetNeeds to search for relevant butter/food/utensil visuals; mentioning a search only in prose is insufficient. The worker must perform search, candidate inspection, selection, scoped import/placement and verification itself. For visuals only, an assetNeed may be optional so a recorded unsuccessful search/inspection can lead to a clearly disclosed procedural alternative. Do not skip the search. Simple floor, UI layout, counters and interaction logic may be authored directly. Code-driven animation of the object is allowed.
3. Use actual returned candidates and receipts. Required audio needs actual listening evidence plus playback; visual assets need actual visual verification. Reject bad candidates and retry within Takko's limits. No external assistant will search/select/import assets, write game code, rewrite your plan or rescue failures. Do not promise success before these steps execute. Use reasonable defaults and return no clarification questions for incidental design choices.

assetNeeds.role: Sound effect played when the player clicks or taps the butter to perform a crunch.
assetNeeds.query: crunch bite crisp food impact sound effect
assetNeeds.constraints: Clear, satisfying crunch or bite sound effect under 2 seconds, no silence at start.

assetNeeds.role: Visual 3D model for the butter stick sitting on the pedestal.
assetNeeds.constraints: Single clean butter mesh or model, textured/colored yellow/gold, under 5 studs length.

assetNeeds.role: Visual cutting board or plate prop on top of the stage.
assetNeeds.constraints: Small tabletop cutting board or ceramic plate under 8 studs wide.

spec.assetStrategy: Audio is sourced directly from the Roblox Creator Store via Marketplace queries for realistic/cartoony crunch sound effects and marked as mandatory. Visual 3D props (butter stick model and cutting board/plate) are searched via Marketplace assets with graceful, high-fidelity procedural part fallbacks if marketplace queries fail inspection. Object animation (squish, compression, recovery) and particle effects are code-driven and tween-based.
spec.title: Butter Crunch
spec.summary: Butter Crunch is a focused tactile interaction game. The player spawns in front of a sleek, brightly lit kitchen counter pedestal holding a golden stick of butter. Interacting via mouse click, touch tap, or proximity prompt triggers an immediate, satisfying crunch: the butter visibly squishes down with dynamic butter flake particles, plays a synchronized marketplace crunch sound effect, and cleanly rebounds back to pristine shape. A bold, modern counter at the top of the screen begins at 0, increments exactly once per full crunch cycle (reaching 10 after 10 distinct crunches), and enforces strict debounce locking to eliminate double-counting on spam or overlapping inputs across desktop and mobile devices.
spec.visualDirection: Bright, clean, cozy culinary aesthetic with a warm studio lighting atmosphere. The central focal point is a wooden cutting board pedestal supporting a stylized, rich golden butter stick with a soft bevel. When crunched, the butter dynamically compresses vertically, flattens outward with subtle squish deformation, and emits golden butter crumb particles before smoothly tweening back to its original resting form. The HUD uses a clean, high-contrast cream-and-gold card with crisp typography showing the crunch counter.

requirements.acceptance: The butter object is positioned stably at the center of the pedestal and is clearly distinguishable and targetable.
